articles.title: 400 Gold Coins Found at the Bottom of the Sea!
articles.summary: Divers found 400 gold coins off England's coast. It took 30 years to figure out which ship they came from!

articles.title: Meet Arcy Drive: The Band That Makes ‘Attic Rock’
articles.summary: Four friends from Long Island started a band called Arcy Drive. They play 'attic rock' — a mix of emo and garage rock — and are now playing big festivals!

articles.title: Bob Dylan’s Guitarist Quit — So a Blues Player from Chicago Stepped In!
articles.summary: Bob Dylan's guitarist quit suddenly before a show. A blues guitarist from Chicago, Joel Paterson, stepped in and played the whole concert alone!
